title: RepoAssure Representative Multi-Mode Acceptance Target Acquisition Authorization Maintainer Decision Recording v0.1
objective: Record explicit lane-scoped target acquisition authorization decisions for Web, Python/CLI, and MCP/Agent without acquiring, installing, analyzing, executing, or writing any target.
acceptance: Record one explicit approve_acquisition, reject, or defer decision for each of Web, Python/CLI, and MCP/Agent.

Accept approve_acquisition only when the decision names an exact source, immutable revision or digest, owner and license evidence, privacy and secret review plan, acquisition-only network and command envelope, disposable destination, allowed outputs, expiry, stop conditions, and cleanup.
Keep any lane with missing, ambiguous, stale, or conflicting evidence deferred.
Do not treat authorization to execute this Goal as target acquisition authorization.
Do not acquire, clone, install, start, analyze, execute, or write any target while recording decisions.

Do not authorize execution through an acquisition decision; do not publish, deploy, launch, modify repository controls, contact anyone, change pricing or spend, change detector or acceptance behavior, or infer final product acceptance.
